question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pleases**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pleases**" means to cause to feel happy and satisfied. (प्रसन्न करना)
 
• In context, showing interest in other people's** interests** makes them happy and satisfied, enhancing your reputation as a good conversationalist.
 
• The other options: "**admits**," "**accompanies**," and "**advances**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *There is nothing that pleases__ people so much as your interest in their interest.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Admits (मानना)**: means to confess or acknowledge something.
 
• **Accompanies (साथ देना)**: means to go somewhere with someone.
 
• **Advances (प्रगति करना)**: means to move forward in a purposeful way.

37:Tced,

The correct answer is: Option 2.</b&
